Rotation context is mixed-to-weak rather than confirming broad rotation: BlockchainCenter scores are 29 (30d), 51 (90d), and 39 (365d); the CMC 90-day published score is 55. Both 90-day states are between published thresholds.

The recent completed W41 reference showed sharp BTC and ETH declines, a falling ETH/BTC ratio, and five settled sessions of negative reported ETF flows for both assets. The latest settled ETF rows are dated October 16 and are not current-session confirmation.
BTC funding increased versus the preceding capture and BTC open interest rose; ETH open interest also rose. These short capture-to-capture changes do not establish excessive leverage or distribution.

The supplied protection calibration describes elevated renewed-retest risk after W41, but all cited cohorts are LOW confidence and descriptive; it does not establish a current warning, exit rule, or confirmed distribution.
